backtest_protocol.execution_model: Candidates scan the broad backfilled FINRA liquid universe. FINRA biweekly rows are joined PIT by publication date (usable_trade_date <= signal date), latest print within 25 days only. The fixed borrow-pressure gate (days_to_cover >= 3.0 AND short_interest_change_pct > 0) plus signal-date OHLCV confirmation selects top-1/day. Core baseline is unchanged core-only; broad paper trades are an additive overlay. Next-open entry, 10-day exit, entry/exit slippage, ROUND_TRIP_COST_PCT.
backtest_protocol.source: docs/backtesting.md canonical three-window core replay plus replay-only broad warehouse default-off paper overlay

gate3.note: No new core filter or entry rule was added. The candidate source is additive default-off paper, so core signals generated/survived are unchanged from baseline.

hypothesis: candidate_pool: PIT FINRA borrow-pressure (days_to_cover >= 3.0 AND short_interest_change_pct > 0) scanned over the broad liquid universe with liquid SPY-relative confirmation may add positive next-open 10-day replacement value on top of the core baseline across all three windows.
interpretation: Broad-universe FINRA borrow-pressure did not clear Gate 4 (failed: window_ev_regression, window_pnl_regression, fewer_than_two_ev_improved_windows, drawdown_drift_too_high, accepted_compression_ev_not_beaten, accepted_compression_pnl_not_beaten, accepted_distribution_ev_not_beaten, accepted_distribution_pnl_not_beaten). The squeeze-fuel effect does not produce robust replacement value even in the broad short-interest population; do not retune the fixed thresholds on the frozen windows.

Do not threshold-sweep the frozen windows.

pre_run_questions.4_acceptance_standard: Use docs/backtesting.md canonical three windows. Aggregate EV/PnL must be positive, no window EV/PnL regression, at least two EV-improved windows, at least 20 paper trades across all 3 windows, survival >=5%, drawdown drift <=0.5pp, concentration pass, and accepted compression/distribution candidate-pool comparators must be beaten. Replay-only positives are leads until shared daily/backtest parity exists.

prediction.confidence_reason: The core universe is too liquid for days-to-cover above three, so exp-20260616-024 had a thin fragile signal; the broad liquid universe holds the higher-short small and mid names where forced covering is strongest, and the archive now covers all three windows. Disconfirmer: a broad squeeze pool may concentrate in a few violent names, relabel small-cap momentum, or fail comparator and drawdown guards.

execution_envelope.failure_handling: missing FINRA row published on/before signal date, stale latest print, days_to_cover below 3.0, non-positive short-interest change, missing broad-universe OHLCV, missing next open, or missing 10d exit rejects the paper candidate
